definition.en: Public Sector Banks (PSBs) are financial institutions where the majority stake is held by the Government of India, playing a pivotal role in the nation's banking system.
definition.hi: Public Sector Banks (PSBs) are financial institutions where the majority stake is held by the Government of India, playing a pivotal role in the nation's banking system.

importanceInUpsc.en: PSBs are critical for understanding financial inclusion, credit flow to priority sectors, and government intervention in the economy. Questions frequently appear in GS-3 regarding banking reforms, non-performing assets, and the role of state-owned entities in economic development.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the structural role of PSBs in the Indian economy.
